title: C-6 — Run manifest
description:
One JSON per run, written by the launcher BEFORE the run and finalised after. F-20: every experiment reproducible from a single config file plus a seed.

`vehicle` is 'hardware' or 'simulator', and F-24 requires every simulated figure to be labelled. Make the figure scripts READ THIS FIELD and stamp the plot automatically — labelling by hand fails exactly once, in the final report.

vehicle.description: F-24: figure scripts read this and stamp simulated plots automatically.

trace_sha256.description: The trace's identity everywhere downstream. Replay client verifies before t0.

warmup_s.description: Drives is_warmup in C-5, computed from the trace's intended_offset_s in BOTH vehicles.

cost_model_snapshots.description: node_id -> C-3 snapshot_id. Which snapshot each node's estimate came from.

items.description:
Everything runtime-specific — ignore_eos, min_tokens/max_tokens, slot reuse disabled — is set once at engine construction and recorded HERE, so the settings that eliminate your confounds are auditable from the results.

F-9: every POOL node runs the same engine (llama.cpp + GGUF). Engine and quantization are held constant so that the heterogeneity ratio R is a property of hardware and node configuration ALONE. What varies per node is engine_config (F-9a). A node with role='engine_gap_probe' is the F-9b measured condition and is NOT a pool member: it participates in no policy comparison.

engine.description: F-9: 'llamacpp' for every pool member. 'vllm' is legal ONLY on a node with role='engine_gap_probe' (F-9b).

quant.description: GGUF quantization for pool nodes, e.g. 'Q4_K_M'. Held constant across the pool (F-9).

gpu.description: 'none' for CPU-only nodes. The pool spans GPU and CPU machines running the SAME engine.

role.description: F-9b: the engine-gap probe is a measured condition, not a pool member. It appears in no figure other than the engine-gap result, and the pipeline MUST exclude it from every policy comparison.

engine_config.description: F-9a: per-node capability, expressed as runtime parameters of the single engine. THIS IS WHAT SETS R. Because R is now synthesized from configuration rather than from engine differences, these values are part of the experimental condition and must be recorded per run, not merely per machine.

parallel.description: llama.cpp --parallel: the fixed slot count. This is exactly SimNode.batch_capacity in the DES — the simulator's node model is now exact rather than approximate.

f18_status.description: 'partial' when the pinned engine version does not expose the prefill/decode split. Record it here rather than faking the split.

send_lag_violations.description: Non-zero => run marked invalid and NOT analysed.

colocated_nodes.description: F-9a: throttling MUST be applied to distinct physical machines. Co-located logical nodes contend for PCIe, memory bandwidth and cache, which would reintroduce as contention the confound F-9 (single engine) removes. Count of nodes sharing a `host` with another node. MUST be 0 for a valid run.
